concept: VPC endpoints: S3 access only from the VPC (gateway endpoint + aws:sourceVpce)
tests: How to guarantee an S3 bucket is accessed only from within the VPC, never over the public internet.
expected: Gateway VPC endpoint for S3 + a bucket policy with an aws:sourceVpce condition allowing access only through that endpoint. Triggers: "only accessed from within its VPC", "never over the public internet".
why_not: ACLs can't restrict access by VPC; a NAT gateway sends traffic over the internet; Transfer Acceleration uses public edge locations.
